tools.name: HWiNFO
tools.desc: Deep hardware info and live sensors (temps, voltages, fans).
tools.why: The most thorough free sensor/monitoring tool - the one techs trust for real temps and health.

tools.name: CrystalDiskInfo
tools.desc: Drive SMART health and temperature at a glance.
tools.why: Instant, clear SMART verdict - the standard for checking if a drive is dying.

tools.name: CPU-Z
tools.why: The reference for confirming exactly what hardware is in front of you.

tools.name: GPU-Z
tools.desc: Graphics card details, sensors and BIOS.
tools.why: Confirms the real GPU (spots fakes/relabels) and dumps the vBIOS.

tools.name: HWMonitor
tools.why: Quick, no-install sensor snapshot.

tools.name: Malwarebytes
tools.why: The default second-opinion cleaner in almost every shop.

tools.name: AdwCleaner
tools.why: Fast one-shot clean of the junk Malwarebytes leaves behind.

tools.name: ESET Online Scanner
tools.why: Strong detection, no install, great for a clean confirmation.

tools.name: Kaspersky Virus Removal Tool
tools.why: Heavy-hitter detection for stubborn infections.

tools.name: CrystalDiskMark
tools.why: The standard quick benchmark - great for proving a slow or fake drive.

tools.name: WizTree
tools.why: Near-instant on huge drives - has largely replaced WinDirStat.

tools.name: Everything
tools.desc: Instant filename search across the drive.
tools.why: Finds any file in milliseconds - a daily-driver for techs.

tools.name: Recuva
tools.why: Simple, effective free undelete.

tools.name: Rufus
tools.why: The bootable-USB tool - tiny, portable, can strip Win11 TPM checks.

tools.name: Ventoy
tools.desc: Boot many ISOs from one USB stick.
tools.why: Drop ISOs on a stick and boot any of them - a shop essential now.

tools.name: Macrium Reflect
tools.why: The reliable choice for a full image before risky work.

tools.name: Clonezilla
tools.why: Free, handles bad sectors well for drive migrations.

tools.name: MemTest86
tools.why: The definitive RAM test - bootable, thorough.

tools.name: OCCT
tools.desc: CPU, GPU, RAM and PSU stability testing.
tools.why: All-in-one stability + power testing, now free for personal use.

tools.name: FurMark
tools.desc: GPU stress test and stability check.
tools.why: Quickly flushes out a failing or overheating GPU.

tools.name: Prime95
tools.why: Max-heat CPU/thermal test - exposes paste/cooler problems.

tools.name: 7-Zip
tools.why: Opens everything - the universal archiver.

tools.name: Autoruns
tools.why: Nothing hides from it - the autostart/persistence gold standard.

tools.name: Process Explorer
tools.why: See exactly what a process is and does - with VirusTotal built in.

tools.name: BlueScreenView
tools.desc: NirSoft - read and decode BSOD dumps.
tools.why: Fast BSOD decode when you want a second read on crash dumps.

tools.name: Revo Uninstaller
tools.why: Rips out stubborn apps and their registry/leftover junk.

tools.name: Ninite
tools.desc: Install/update common apps in one go.
tools.why: Bulk-installs clean apps with no toolbars - huge time-saver on rebuilds.

tools.name: Snappy Driver Installer Origin
tools.why: Offline driverpacks for machines with no network drivers.

tools.name: Display Driver Uninstaller (DDU)
tools.why: The only clean way to fully strip NVIDIA/AMD/Intel GPU drivers before a reinstall.

tools.name: O&O ShutUp10++
tools.why: Fast, portable way to tame Windows telemetry and bloat settings.

tools.name: ThrottleStop
tools.desc: Diagnose and fix laptop CPU throttling.
tools.why: Go-to for laptop thermal/throttling and undervolting problems.

tools.name: AnyDesk
tools.why: Fast, low-bandwidth remote support.

tools.name: TeamViewer
tools.why: The widely-recognised remote-support standard.

tools.name: Fab's AutoBackup 7 Pro
tools.desc: Backs up and restores user data, profiles and settings across multiple accounts - and migrates straight from a dead PC's drive over USB. Windows XP through 11.
tools.why: A technician staple for data migrations and rebuilds. Portable, reliable, fairly priced, and it saves real time on every reload. Supporting the developer keeps a genuinely useful shop tool alive - well worth the licence.
